avis.texte: I love this, it's too moisturizing for dry skin, I've never tried anything like this, excellent formula and very good price, I love it
It is a very lightweight hydrating spray perfect for all types of weather. It leaves my skin feeling moisturized all day. The only downside is it has a very strong honey scent to it.
Very strong honey scent, but I like it. It works well with my dry skin, but the scent is so strong and sweet
